verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Stripe Connect exposes a full API (docs-5, docs-6) and references official package distribution via npm (probe-1), plus AI-friendly docs (llms.txt) and an official MCP server/CLI (probe-4, probe-5), all of which support AI-native SDK-based development. However, the pack never explicitly documents a dedicated 'Official SDKs' page or lists supported languages, so the SDK claim is inferred rather than directly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit official SDK/library documentation page, multi-language SDK examples, independent developer confirmation of SDK usage for Connect specifically.
